infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The assistant listens through your microphone during voice conversations — on your runs, walks, and at your desk.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Takes photos for your health record. Each one is encrypted on this phone before it is stored in your own account.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lets you attach photos from your library. Health photos are encrypted on this phone before they are stored in your own account.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads daily sleep, heart, steps, weight and cycle data so they can be kept in your own health record. Nothing is written back to Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: My OS never writes to Apple Health. This permission is listed only because the Health library can write; the app does not ask for it.

plugins.photosPermission: Lets you attach photos and videos from your library: to send a task to your assistant, or to add to your health record (encrypted on this phone first).

plugins.cameraPermission: Takes photos for your health record. Each one is encrypted on this phone before it is stored in your own account.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads daily sleep, heart, steps, weight and cycle data so they can be kept in your own health record. Nothing is written back to Health.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: My OS never writes to Apple Health. This permission is listed only because the Health library can write; the app does not ask for it.
